name: es30-interactive-3d-scene
title: Interactive 3D Scene (capstone)
summary: Capstone: a small outdoor scene explored with an FPS camera (mouse look, WASD/QE, wheel zoom) combining procedural mipmapped textures, tangent-space normal mapping, a Blinn-Phong sun with a PCF shadow map, instanced pillars and trees (divisors + current attribute values), a cube-map sky drawn last and exponential fog, with number-key toggles. Fixed poses are compared with a CPU ray caster, every toggle changes the image where predicted, and a scripted input sequence ends at the CPU-predicted pose.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.8 Vertex Specification (current generic attribute values)
ES 3.0 §2.9 Vertex Arrays (VertexAttribDivisor), §2.9.3 Drawing Commands (DrawArraysInstanced; current values unaffected by enabled arrays)
ES 3.0 §3.6.1 Basic Polygon Rasterization (perspective-correct interpolation, front faces), §3.6.2 Depth Offset (eq. 3.9-3.11)
ES 3.0 §3.8.2 Sampler Objects, §3.8.4 Immutable-Format Texture Images
ES 3.0 §3.8.10 Texture Minification (scale factor approximations, mipmap level selection), §3.8.11 Texture Magnification
ES 3.0 §3.8.13 Texture Completeness, §3.8.15 Texture Comparison Modes
ES 3.0 §4.1.2 Scissor Test, §4.1.5 Depth Buffer Test, §4.1.9 Dithering
ES 3.0 §4.2.3 Clearing the Buffers, §4.3.2 Reading Pixels
ES 3.0 §4.4.2 Attaching Images to Framebuffer Objects, §4.4.4 Framebuffer Completeness
ES 3.0 §6.1.12 Shader and Program Queries (GetVertexAttrib: ARRAY_DIVISOR, CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB)
GLSL ES 3.00 §8.5 Geometric Functions (reflect, normalize), §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions (sampler2DShadow, samplerCube), §8.9 Fragment Processing Functions (fwidth)

api.glGenVertexArrays: one VAO per mesh/instance configuration (10) plus an empty VAO; each drives validated draws
api.glBindVertexArray: VAO selection per draw; divisor and enable state read back per VAO
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: attributes 0-4 per vertex; 5/6 only in instanced VAOs (trunk VAO: 6 disabled, read back)
api.glVertexAttribPointer: interleaved 15-float vertices and 7-float instance records; positions, normals, uvs, tangents, barycentrics all observed in pixels
api.glVertexAttribDivisor: divisor 1 on a_instance/a_tint: each pillar instance appears at its CPU-projected position with its tint; ARRAY_DIVISOR read back (1 vs 0)
api.glVertexAttrib4f: current value (0,0,0,1) of a_instance places every non-instanced object exactly where the CPU model has it; read back after instanced draws
api.glVertexAttrib3f: current value (1,1,1) of a_tint for non-instanced objects and the trunks; read back after instanced draws
api.glGetVertexAttribiv: VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_DIVISOR (1 in the pillar VAO, 0 in the wall VAO), VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_ENABLED (0 for a_tint in the trunk VAO)
api.glGetVertexAttribfv: CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB of locations 5 and 6 unchanged by the instanced draws (ES 3.0 2.9.3)
api.glDrawArraysInstanced: 6 pillars, 10 trunks, 10 canopies; instanceCount 5 removes exactly the last pillar (negative control: background predicted by the CPU shows through)
api.glDrawArrays: non-indexed meshes (barycentric wireframe), the sky cube and the attribute-less inset triangle; all compared with the CPU model
api.glGenBuffers: vertex and instance buffers feeding the validated draws
api.glBindBuffer: ARRAY_BUFFER captured by the attribute pointers (vertex and instance buffers)
api.glBufferData: mesh and instance data observed through the rendered pixels
api.glGenTextures: 4 albedo textures, the normal map, the sky cube map and the shadow map, all sampled in validated pixels
api.glBindTexture: per-object albedo on unit 0; the same depth texture on units 2 (compare) and 3 (raw via sampler)
api.glActiveTexture: fixed units 0-4; SAMPLER_BINDING of unit 3 read back
api.glTexStorage2D: RGBA8 128x128 with 8 levels, cube map 256x256, DEPTH_COMPONENT24 2048x2048
api.glTexSubImage2D: every mip level of the CPU-built chains and every cube face; the CPU texel-range model of levels 0..floor(log2 F)+1 bounds every textured pixel
api.glTexParameteri: LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR/REPEAT (texel-range model), LINEAR cube map, COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE + LEQUAL + LINEAR on the shadow map (lit/shadowed ground and toggle 1); compare mode read back
api.glGenSamplers: raw-depth sampler object for the inset
api.glSamplerParameteri: COMPARE_MODE NONE + NEAREST: inset grey levels equal the CPU-traced shadow-map depths
api.glBindSampler: unit 3 reads raw depth while unit 2 compares the same texture; SAMPLER_BINDING read back
api.glGenFramebuffers: depth-only shadow framebuffer used by pass 1
api.glBindFramebuffer: pass 1 into the shadow FBO, passes 2/3 into the default framebuffer; both observed
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: DEPTH_ATTACHMENT = shadow map: stored depths shown by the inset match analytic depths
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: COMPLETE required for the depth-only FBO (init fails otherwise)
api.glGetUniformLocation: uniforms of the four programs; their effects observed in pixels
api.glUseProgram: scene, shadow, sky and inset programs each produce validated output
api.glUniform1i: sampler units and the technique toggles (shadows, normal mapping, Blinn, wire): each toggle changes the image where predicted
api.glUniform1f: fog density (fog at known distances), shadow texel/bias, specular and shininess (Blinn-Phong values)
api.glUniform2f: inset depth range: grey levels match the CPU
api.glUniform3f: eye, sun, ambient, fog and wire colours, albedo: observed through the lighting equation
api.glUniformMatrix3fv: normal matrices of rotated boxes: face shading matches the CPU
api.glUniformMatrix4fv: model, view-projection, light and sky matrices: geometry, shadows and sky directions match the ray caster
api.glViewport: 2048x2048 shadow viewport, full window, inset viewport: probes land where the CPU predicts
api.glScissor: the inset frame clear is confined: every probe outside the inset is unchanged
api.glEnable: DEPTH_TEST (nearest hit wins, sky only where nothing is drawn), POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL (no acne on lit probes), SCISSOR_TEST
api.glDisable: SCISSOR_TEST after the inset frame clear (the next frame's full-window depth clear works: every later pose matches), POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL after pass 1
api.glDepthFunc: LESS for the scene, LEQUAL for the sky at depth 1.0 (sky probes match)
api.glPolygonOffset: factor 4.5 derived from the PCF footprint: all lit probes, including faces at n.L 0.35, are fully lit; bound of the inset depth check
api.glClearDepthf: 1.0: the sky's depth-1.0 fragments pass with LEQUAL
api.glClear: DEPTH of both passes; scissored COLOR for the inset frame
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE read-back of every validated frame

visual_review.notes: Start view at 256x256, 640x480, 800x800 and 333x777 on radeonsi, llvmpipe, zink and ANGLE (lavapipe), identical across drivers: meadow fading into a pale horizon under a blue gradient sky, stone wall with three bevelled panels (left), wooden crate with frame and planks, striped beach ball, dark-blue monolith on a bevelled plinth, colonnade of six cream pillars (right), round trees; sun from the right, so crate/ball shadows and long striped pillar shadows fall to the left; portrait keeps the scene width (fov across the shorter side). All seven validation poses viewed at 512x512: shadow view shows the monolith's long shadow, specular view a white-to-blue Blinn-Phong highlight on the monolith face against the sky, wall close-up with lit/dark bevels, colonnade from the side with all six pillars, sky view with sun disc and glow, fog view of open ground to the horizon. Key 4: magenta triangle edges on boxes and the ground grid, lines fading out on far ground and small sphere facets; key 5: shadow-map inset with white frame, objects as dark blobs on the depth gradient. Interactive run under Xvfb + xdotool (llvmpipe): W walked forward, left-drag turned right, wheel zoomed in, keys 1/3/4/5 toggled with console feedback.
